title: dev : aaps crash after install
symptom: After installing the APK from the dev branch, clicking the open button causes AAPS to crash systematically.
cause: The crash is in the OpenHuman module in OHCounterDelegate.kt at line 12, where sp.getLong("openhumans_counter", 1) throws an exception, likely due to an issue in the Android library.
fix: A commit (dc90c6b140e9df77b5739ba1ccd32a951cc83bae) was made to resolve the crash, and the user confirmed the problem is fixed.
evidence_quote: I don't undestand how this could happen (crash is in android lib) but this should resolve it https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/dc90c6b140e9df77b5739ba1ccd32a951cc83bae
